name: Piper TTS
summary: Fast local neural text-to-speech system optimized for low-latency offline CPU voice replies inside SillyTavern, Home Assistant & Open WebUI.
ranking_rationale: Runs sub-100ms offline voice generation purely on CPU—saving 100% of GPU VRAM for your LLM (trade-off: slightly more robotic prosody than heavier VRAM models like Kokoro or XTTSv2).

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.
